NIDHI PUROHIT

Investment Banking Operations | Middle Office | Equity and Fixed Income Settlement | SWIFT | Reconciliation | Fail Management +91- 9695690014 | nidhipurohit1999@gmail.com | Pune, Maharashtra - 411057 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/nidhipurohit

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Investment Banking Operations Associate with 3.5+ years of experience at State Street Corporation, specializing in middle-office functions, trade life cycle management, reconciliations, and equity/fixed income settlements. Proven track record of maintaining 99.9% accuracy across 1,000+ daily transactions and reducing end-of-day trade failures by 80%. Experienced in investigating cash and trade breaks, reconciling custody and internal records, and driving timely resolution with brokers, clients, and counterparties. Skilled in OTC Derivatives settlements across EMEA markets, SWIFT messaging, pre-matching, fail trade investigation, and client/broker relations. Adept at leveraging GTM, IMS, IMT, Salesforce CRM, and multiple custody portals to drive operational excellence.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS

Systems & Tools Salesforce CRM | GTM | IMS | IMT | CSM | Custody Portals | SWIFT | Alert SSI | Microsoft Excel (Advanced) | Microsoft Word | Bloomberg (Basic) | PSET | BIC | TI Protocols

Core Competencies Trade Settlements (Equity & Fixed Income) | OTC Derivatives | Middle Office Operations | Trade Life Cycle Management | Reconciliation & Break Management | Cash, Position & Trade Reconciliation | Pre-Matching & SD Workflows | Fail Trades Investigation & Resolution | EMEA Market Operations | Client & Broker Relations | EOD Reporting | Risk & Exposure Management

WORK EXPERIENCE

State Street Corporation, Pune | Associate-2 | February 2023 – Present

Managed end-to-end Trade Settlements for OTC Derivatives across EMEA Markets (Equity) including pre- matching, settlement date (SD) workflows, and claims processing for high-volume portfolios exceeding 1,000+ complex transactions daily with a 99.9% accuracy rate.

Utilized GTM, IMS, IMT applications, and multiple custody portals to monitor, track, and process trade transactions in real time.

Applied deep expertise in Alert SSI, SWIFT, PSET, BIC, and TI protocols to ensure compliant and timely



settlement instructions. Investigated and resolved failed trades systematically, reducing end-of-day trade failures by 80% and significantly decreasing financial exposure and operational risk.

Conducted detailed trade investigations across custody portals and internal reports to verify matching status and guarantee successful settlement outcomes.

Performed daily cash, position, and trade reconciliations between internal records, custody portals, and broker statements; investigated discrepancies and drove break resolution within agreed timelines.

Reviewed reconciliation exception reports and aged breaks, prioritized high-risk items, and coordinated with internal teams, brokers, and clients to prevent settlement delays and financial exposure.

Updated trade comments in CSM accurately based on real-time custody status and specific processing issues, ensuring audit-ready documentation.

Efficiently managed ad-hoc queries, aged issues, and time-sensitive escalations via Salesforce CRM, liaising directly with senior-level contacts at client and broker firms.

Transmitted formal instructions via fax and electronic channels for Depot movements, payments, economic parameter amendments, cash breaks, and SEDOL/ISIN movements.

Led daily client calls to provide pre-matching, SD, and fails updates, clearly communicating critical settlement statuses and escalating ongoing issues proactively.

Conducted weekly broker calls to highlight key processing bottlenecks and deliver comprehensive updates on pre- matching, SD, and failed trades.

• Generated and audited End of Day (EOD) Reports covering pre-matching, SD, and fail metrics; ensured data

accuracy and timely distribution to stakeholders.

Liaised with External Advisors and counterparties to track, follow up on, and resolve pending or failing trade settlements within SLA timelines.

Received formal client appreciation for delivering time-critical requirements and proactively handling complex operational issues.

Mentored junior team members on trade lifecycle processes and operational best practices, contributing to team capability uplift.

Contributed to process improvement initiatives that enhanced operational workflow efficiency and reduced manual intervention in settlement processing.

EDUCATION

Master of Business Administration (MBA) – Finance & Operations Sinhgad College of Engineering, Pune (Maharashtra) | 2022 | Score: 75%

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com) North Maharashtra University, Jalgaon (Maharashtra) | 2020 | Score: 70%

12th Grade – HSC GD Bendale Public School, Jalgaon (Maharashtra) | 2017 | Score: 64%

CERTIFICATIONS & PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

1. 2. 3. 4.

NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives Certification (Completed / In Progress) Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & KYC Compliance Training – State Street Internal Excel for Financial Analysis – Advanced Level SWIFT Fundamentals & Financial Messaging – Self-Study / On-the-Job Training

AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS

5.

6.

Formal Client Appreciation Award – Recognized by client for delivering time-critical requirements and proactively resolving complex operational issues (State Street Corporation, 2024). Consistent high-performer maintaining 99.9% settlement accuracy across 1,000+ daily transactions in EMEA markets.

SOFT SKILLS

Analytical Thinking | Problem-Solving | Stakeholder Communication | Team Collaboration | Ownership & Accountability | Attention to Detail | Time Management | Cross-functional Coordination
